messages:
Alyssa Chen: Heads-up — Cobalt Labs renewal is next Tuesday. They want a concise SLA pack: uptime history, p95 trend, explicit credit calc if the monthly SLO was breached. @Raj can you pull 60d telemetry and a short CSV? @Emma can you confirm root cause for the big spike on 03/04? Need a customer-facing one-pager + an internal action list by EOD tomorrow.

Raj Patel: On it. Quick 60d headline: uptime 99.962%, p50 ~70ms, p95 ~260ms. Notable tail spike 2026-03-04 14:10 UTC. Uploading export and a tiny chart now.

Emma Rivera: That 03/04 spike correlates with a control-plane GC that coincided with a burst of rebalances; backend queueing increased token latency for some requests. No model changes deployed at that window. We added a GC safety margin patch after the incident.

Mike O'Neill: Contract specifics for Cobalt: monthly uptime 99.9%, p95 <=200ms. Their contract defines credit if >1.5% of minutes exceed p95 during billing period. Initial calc shows ~2.2% of minutes over threshold this month  so they meet the threshold and are eligible. I will compute the monetary credit and draft the customer email.

Olivia Park: Renewal enablement note: they brought this up on the last call and want the credit number and an ops remediation plan visible in the deck. We should be explicit about next steps and timelines.

Alyssa Chen: Action items: (1) Raj  attach raw CSV + link to chart, (2) Emma  2-3 sentence RCA for the customer slide, (3) Mike  compute credit amount and draft the proposed credit line for the renewal deck, (4) Olivia  draft the one-pager and mark any concessions. I'll assemble the deck and send a review invite. Meeting Thurs 9:00 AM PT to finalize.

Raj Patel: Export link: https://redwood.internal/metrics/cobalt/2012345678
CSV excerpt:
```
date,p50_ms,p95_ms,uptime_pct,minutes_over_p95_pct
2026-02-01,68,190,100,0.2
2026-03-04,75,320,99.95,3.1
2026-03-05,70,210,99.98,1.6
2026-03-30,69,205,99.96,1.9
```
Full export in shared drive.

Emma Rivera: RCA copy for deck:
"On 2026-03-04 Cobalt experienced elevated p95 latency driven by a control-plane GC that caused increased backend queueing during rebalance operations. Root cause: aggressive GC tuning combined with simultaneous rebalances. Immediate mitigation: increased GC headroom and staggered rebalances; permanent fixes: GC safety margin, pre-rebalance health checks, and an alert for tail-latency during infrastructure events. Patch deployed 2026-03-06."

Mike O'Neill: Credit calculation (preliminary): per contract, credit = prorated % of monthly fee based on minutes over threshold. With ~2.2% over threshold we estimate an 8% invoice credit for the affected month. I'll finalize the exact dollar amount and add wording that this is a one-time remediation credit tied to the March billing cycle. Recommendation: include the 8% credit in the renewal deck as a concession to close.

Olivia Park: +1 to offering 8% as a one-time remediation credit, but present it as conditional on renewal signing and on our delivery of the listed mitigations. We'll use it to reduce churn risk.

Alyssa Chen: Thanks. I'll draft the 1-pager and internal action queue and post here by EOD. Meeting invite sent for Thu 9:00 AM PT. If anyone adds anything else, drop it below.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Cobalt Labs SLA review  Thursday 9:00 AM PT (invite sent to participants).
